sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: The original northern border pair shortcuts grass and differs from the unchanged OSM northern return by up to76m. Replace it with complete image-estimated limits along the visible paved source route; named configuration remains draft.

measurement.note: Draft complete image-estimated road limits along the unchanged OSM northern-return course candidate.28 native rectified cross-sections on the pinned licensed satellite mosaic supply56 sparse side estimates plus exact closure. The northern return follows visible pavement rather than the displaced original border pair. The eastern shared drag/forecourt corridor includes broad paved areas; its lane identity, access openings and shadowed or low-contrast joins remain estimates. Signed offsets interpolate along the retained source frames and are not independent measurements between controls. Native image blur limits accuracy; pixel spacing and numerical tolerance are not surveyed accuracy. This candidate is not verified as the operator's2.28km National Circuit. No nominal width, length, bank angle or timing coordinate is fitted. Curbs illustrative, terrain estimated and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
